summary: A Cargo-built split-screen page for National Park, a free typeface based on the router-carved signs of US national parks. The left half scrolls through forest-green, black and lime panels of images (ASCII-art title, badges, sign photos, animated GIFs of the router skeleton and of diacritics), while the right half is a fixed type tester (an embedded iframe) that sets every national park's name with Size and Weight sliders. Lime 'Download' bars recur between panels.

instances.feel: Arriving at a park gate at night; campfire-geeky

instances.learn: Borrow the real-world sign formula ('Now entering …') for the lockup and draw the scenery in ASCII characters: the theme and the digital/router origin are both stated before any copy
